The Resource-Demand Differential (RDD) is calculated as the difference between the Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS) and the Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI): RDD = PFIS − FRAI. A higher RDD indicates a greater gap between patient needs and available facility resources.
How many top facilities should I list, ranked by highest RDD?
The task specifies listing the top 100 facilities ranked by highest RDD (Resource-Demand Differential). So you should show up to 100 facilities, ordered by RDD from highest to lowest.
